hypothesis: An opt-in native Go child of original Wingless R5 can learn public next-front consequences online from selected actions and use retained causal-history state to revise a real native Choose decision. Generalize across coordinate/goal while conserving all source R5 custody. No claim of superiority over equally trained conventional Beta controls.
data: ONLY selected before/action/after public returned evidence accepted by original R5 Choose/Feedback; source-public shaped unit fixtures are not original source episodes. Existing F12 originals can be reused only within their historic FIT role; FSA protected firstuse denied.
mechanism: Context is CURRENT FrontBlocked plus PREVIOUS completed action category NONE/LEFT/RIGHT/FORWARD, two eligible current turn arms LEFT/RIGHT. Learn blocked/clear returned front outcomes in uint32 counters only after a validated selected Feedback. Carry counters across episodes, reset previous-action context on BeginEpisode.
select: When current FrontBlocked true, no pending action, both arms have >=4 actual selected matched returned outcomes in same context, difference between Beta(1,1) posterior blocked means >=0.25: prefer lower next-front blocked risk. Else exact R5 baseline. No hidden environment/grid future data.
controls: independent fully fitted equal-information conditional Beta count
guards: original R5 Go checkpoint remains byte-identical and can be loaded without r8
child new checksum checkpoint has strict domain, count conservation and size limit, not a science or source credential
invalid/duplicate Feedback cannot change learned counts
no selected action accepted without exact original pending source custody
do not train R3 from heldout current Feedback, only child belief
no new protected source reset/step or original FSA
